rules: Target company only: sector-context sentences (peer deals, sector consolidation) are not labelled, so external_context types have no gold labels.
A sponsor's investment in the target is labelled pe_holding_period only (not also recently_acquired; Step 7 derives that from the same date). Later restatements of the start date are labelled too.
Every disclosed equity round is labelled large_recent_fundraise as a fact, whatever its size or age. PRD §8 does not define 'large' or 'recent'; Step 7 applies size and recency thresholds.
Acquisitions made BY the target are not a PRD §8 signal and are not labelled.
Advisers on a completed past deal are not advisers_appointed (which means a mandate for a prospective transaction).
Status: confirmed = stated by the company or a deal party; attributed = a report citing a named source; speculative = unsourced conjecture.
Quotes: shortest verbatim span from the article body, max 25 words, never from sidebars or page chrome.
Scope: Evidence usable at the pair anchor (publication_date not None and < anchor) after the Step 6a content_leak exclusion.
